prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Threadbound BLUE HERMIT set, one clean front T-pose costume design image for later 3D reference.
INPUT 1 is the actual bare master doll. Keep that exact same carved pale ivory wood blank oval head, center stitch, NO eyes or facial features, no ears, existing neck length, anatomy, hands and finger size, joint centers, limb lengths and foot stance. Do not use the eye dots or older mannequin body in any other reference. Hands are bare wood and open palms forward; keep the horizontal arms and natural straight legs at exactly the original scale. INPUTS 2 and 3 are costume mood only: broad wicker fishing hat, brown leather and fantasy monk silhouette. Do not imitate their old anatomy, eyes, overlong flying scarves or tall boots.
Create an unmistakably different set from the ragged Base adventurer. Blue is a traveling fantasy monk with lakeside fisher craft: broad, shallow conical woven straw fishing hat with a low crown, visibly clear of shoulder and face, open enough to see the stitched head. Natural honey wicker with plain dark narrow brim bindings. Compact turned blue collar, small and unobtrusive, with no bulky neck cowl. A neat fitted dark tobacco-brown leather vest with rounded seams and three short flax toggle closures across the chest. Contrasting short indigo cloth BELL SLEEVES that flare broadly downward, end above each wooden elbow and have clean, rounded cut edges with pale narrow cloth border. No shoulder armor or ragged tears. One flat wide slate-indigo cloth sash anchored with a low-profile leather clasp. No hip pouch, no stacked belts. Two short rounded split leather hip panels above distinctly full dark slate-indigo trousers; trousers widen visibly through the thigh then taper, cover the knees and reach the boots. Slim low-profile split-toe brown leather shoes and compact slate-blue cloth gaiters ending at the middle of the shin, no large bare calf gaps and no knee-high boots. Slim tobacco leather forearm guards over short indigo wraps with a clear EMPTY small bronze/laced socket on the inner LEFT forearm (viewer right). No attachment or weapon.
Two simple fabric ribbon tails attach behind the body at opposite points: longer rear right shoulder collar tail ends near the hip, shorter rear left waist sash tail ends above the knee. Only slight side glimpses in a true front view; they hang by gravity, held away from glove joins and behind leg silhouette, no exaggerated windswept banners. Keep sleeve border and front sash end broad enough for future embroidery; cloth regions are clear and empty except ordinary construction stitching, no woven motifs or symbols. Primary indigo on collar, sash and tails, secondary muted slate-blue on sleeve lining/trouser cloth/gaiters; natural straw, bronze, leather and pale wood stay visually distinct.
One centered full-body orthographic front pose with hat, soles, finger tips fully visible, 1254-square feel, plain white background, soft neutral lighting, detailed handcrafted painted 3D concept style like input 1. Preserve the exact doll underneath; no new head shape, eye dots, face, human skin, extra jewelry, mask, weapons, trinkets, text, annotation, graphic board, other views or watermark.

Use case: identity-preserve. One clean full-body orthographic BACK T-pose of the exact same Threadbound Blue Hermit fantasy monk outfit from input 1, for a front/back turnaround. Input 1 is authoritative for costume, scale, proportions, palette, materials and all silhouette landmarks. Input 2 is the original doll rear master and is authoritative for exposed rear head, joints and dorsal hands. Same camera distance, height, white background, scale, pose and lighting as input 1. Show the back of the same broad shallow conical woven wicker hat and same blank pale stitched doll head. Arms horizontal, open palms face away from camera, segmented backs of hands and finger plates visible. Feet face away with same soles and low heels visible. Mirror asymmetric details in the correct anatomical sense, not an image flip.
Same fitted tobacco leather vest with round construction seams, low indigo stand collar, full short indigo bell sleeves with pale narrow borders, plain dark brown bracers, wrapped navy/blue cuffs, flat slate-indigo waist sash over two short curved leather hip panels, full tapering dark slate-blue trousers and blue mid-shin wraps with compact split-toe brown shoes. Show rear construction consistent with front, rear vest plain smooth tobacco leather with two shaped seam lines, no front toggles or leather clasp on the back. Small forearm socket is on palmar inside of character LEFT forearm, viewer left from back, and main socket opening is hidden from this angle. No pouch.
Make the TWO ribbon origins especially clear. Long flat indigo ribbon attaches to back LEFT shoulder collar (viewer LEFT in the BACK view) and hangs toward left hip/upper thigh. Shorter flat ribbon attaches to back RIGHT waist sash (viewer RIGHT in the BACK view) and hangs to above knee. These are opposite sides of rear and match visible trails on the front. Gravity rest pose, ribbons drape just off the body, each only a hand-width wide or less, two separate ribbons, no long cape, no flutter or windswept cloth. Front center sash panel is part of the cloth design and cannot be seen across back; no third back ribbon. Plain sleeves and cloth with construction stitches only, no embroidery yet. Full hat, fingers, feet in frame, preserve same core doll proportions, no other angle, human facial features, mask, weapon, attached grapple, labels, embellishments, frame or watermark.

Use case: identity-preserve. Single clean full-body action concept of the EXACT Blue Hermit fantasy monk and same wooden doll from input 1. Keep its distinctive wide shallow wicker fishing hat, blank stitched ivory wood head NO eyes, carved wooden joint and hand construction, fitted brown leather vest with three flax toggles, short indigo bell sleeves with pale thin borders, single flat slate sash, two small leather hip panels, full tapered slate-blue trousers, mid-shin wraps and compact brown split-toe shoes. Keep empty forearm socket. No garments redesigned, no added armor, no mask, no weapon or grapple.
A grounded agile fantasy monk mid-turn on one planted foot, other foot lightly stepped out and knees bent, arms relaxed outward to counterbalance, shown at a three-quarter angle so we can see head and both loose cloth tails. The hat stays fitted to the head with clear brim and no face features. One longer narrow ribbon leads from the back LEFT shoulder collar and trails behind the turn at hip height; one shorter narrow ribbon leads from the opposite back RIGHT side of waist and follows lower on a slightly different arc, with only two loose tails. Show gravity and drag in measured smooth curved ribbon paths as the torso rotates, no floating strips, no whipping over head, no impossibly long ribbons. The broad front sash panel stays close to the body. Tone is calm balance, light footwork, measured movement. Keep all edges in frame and the attachment points readable. Single uncluttered white/light-gray studio background, small soft contact shadow, same illustrative material fidelity and natural studio lighting as input. No magic effects, scenery, diagrams, other poses, arrows, labels, weapons or text.
